lab:news-scout.name: News scout
lab:news-scout.what: Reads a fixed list of engineering blogs and release notes and submits ideas worth trying, each with a source link.
lab:news-scout.when: When a session asks it for fresh ideas.

lab:scout.name: Code scouts
lab:scout.what: Walk one area of the code each and submit small fixes they think are worth doing, each with a file and line.

lab:triage.name: Triage
lab:triage.what: Checks that an idea has a source and is worth the work; takes it, drops it, or parks it for your word.

lab:method.name: Method picker
lab:method.what: Chooses how deep the written plan must be for the size of the change.

lab:builder.name: Builder
lab:builder.what: Makes the change on a branch, following the plan.
lab:builder.when: When an idea has a method.

lab:tester.name: Tester
lab:tester.what: Runs the tests and the checks against the builder's branch.

lab:applier.name: Applier
lab:applier.what: Merges a tested change into the main branch once the plan allows it.

lab:retro.name: Retro
lab:retro.what: Records whether the chosen method worked, so the next pick is better informed.

lab:validator.name: Validator
lab:validator.what: A fresh agent that did not see the builder's reasoning checks the result against the plan's criteria.
lab:validator.when: Last, before an idea counts as shipped.

thread:s-api-ratelimit.name: Rate limiting rollout
thread:s-api-ratelimit.what: Rolls out per-key rate limiting on the public API.

thread:s-research-bench.name: Benchmark runner
thread:s-research-bench.what: Runs the retrieval vs long-context benchmark and keeps the grader honest.

service:sentinel.what: Watches the other services and opens an ask when one of them fails twice in a row.
